expectations.text: Recommends a recursive enum with children behind a Vec
expectations.evidence: enum LayerNode { Leaf, Group } with Group { children: Vec<LayerNode> }.

expectations.text: States no Box is needed because Vec is already heap-backed
expectations.evidence: 'Vec<T> stores its elements behind a heap pointer ... you do not need a Box here.'

expectations.text: Rejects Rc<RefCell>/Arc<Mutex> as the GC-language reflex, citing single owner
expectations.evidence: 'This is the reflex port from a GC language, and it's wrong here.'

expectations.text: Names an index/arena (LayerId) approach as the legitimate alternative
expectations.evidence: 'A flat arena / slotmap with id-based child lists ... legitimate and arguably better at scale.'
